$comment: Index existence gate (phase-02 plan 9.2, optimization §3.5.4). Every index a hot query relies on is listed here; packages/db/test/migrations.int.test.ts fails when a listed name is missing from pg_indexes after `prisma migrate deploy`. P2 created this file; later phases append their rows. `query` names the statement it serves; `explain` says the plan it must keep.

indexes.name: games_referenceId_key
indexes.query: getGameSnapshot (RSC, every game page load); socket loadLiveGame (once per session); POST /api/games/[ref]/*

indexes.name: games_pkey
indexes.query: socket checkpoint UPDATE … WHERE id = $1 (≤ 10 per game), finish CTE, abort

indexes.name: games_open_idx
indexes.query: socket boot restore list; boot/opportunistic stale sweep; daily stale bot sweep; stale waiting-game expiry
indexes.explain: Index Scan (or Bitmap Index Scan) using games_open_idx; never a Seq Scan on games

indexes.name: games_source_externalId_key
indexes.query: P4 import upsert ON CONFLICT (source, "externalId")

indexes.name: games_white_player_idx
indexes.query: ON DELETE SET NULL from users (P10 account deletion) without a scan

indexes.name: games_black_player_idx
indexes.query: ON DELETE SET NULL from users (P10 account deletion) without a scan

indexes.name: games_rematch_of_idx
indexes.query: createRematch NOT EXISTS guard; ON DELETE SET NULL from games; rematch chain length

indexes.name: game_players_pkey
indexes.query: participant check on GET /api/games/[ref], checkpoint, complete, PGN (≤ 2 rows); finish CTE join

indexes.name: game_players_gameId_color_key
indexes.query: one row per side (a join race inserts the second row → unique violation → 409)

indexes.name: game_players_userId_endedAt_gameId_idx
indexes.query: my live games WHERE "userId" = $1 AND "endedAt" IS NULL; P3 archive keyset ORDER BY "endedAt" DESC, "gameId" DESC; user-delete cascade
indexes.explain: Index Scan using game_players_userId_endedAt_gameId_idx; no Sort over game_players

indexes.name: idempotency_keys_pkey
indexes.query: POST /api/games Idempotency-Key insert ON CONFLICT ("userId", key) DO NOTHING

indexes.name: idempotency_keys_createdAt_idx
indexes.query: daily prune DELETE … WHERE "createdAt" < now() - interval '24 hours'

indexes.name: jobs_ready_idx
indexes.query: worker claim: UPDATE jobs … WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE status='QUEUED' AND "runAt" <= now() AND kind::text = ANY($2) ORDER BY priority DESC, "fairSeq", "runAt" LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
indexes.explain: Index Scan using jobs_ready_idx + LockRows, no Sort

indexes.name: jobs_running_idx
indexes.query: worker reaper (boot + drain end): … WHERE status='RUNNING' AND ("heartbeatAt" < now() - interval '3 minutes' OR "lockedBy" LIKE $prefix)
indexes.explain: Index Scan / Bitmap Index Scan using jobs_running_idx

indexes.name: jobs_finished_idx
indexes.query: HOUSEKEEPING prune-jobs: DELETE … WHERE status = 'DONE' AND "finishedAt" < now() - interval '14 days' (FAILED/CANCELLED 30 days)

indexes.name: jobs_dedupeKey_key
indexes.query: enqueue INSERT … ON CONFLICT ("dedupeKey") (packages/db/src/jobs.ts); A1/A2 probe LEFT JOIN jobs ON "dedupeKey" = 'analyze:' || g.id; healKick CAS UPDATE … WHERE "dedupeKey" = $k

indexes.name: game_analyses_pkey
indexes.query: A1 review load and probe; worker checkpoint upsert

indexes.name: player_reviews_pkey
indexes.query: A1 review load and probe; A5 progress UPDATE … WHERE "gameId" = $g AND color = $c

indexes.name: legend_comparisons_pkey
indexes.query: A2/A9 reads, the lazy facts insert ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, A9b attempts CTE, worker READY update

indexes.name: openings_epd_idx
indexes.query: worker deepest-match opening: SELECT eco, name FROM openings WHERE epd = ANY($1::text[]) AND "isActive"

indexes.name: shares_code_key
indexes.query: /r/[code] page and image route (ISR miss only); A11 by code

indexes.name: shares_owner_idx
indexes.query: A10 reuse lookup … WHERE "ownerId"=$1 AND kind='REVIEW' AND "gameId"=$2 … ORDER BY "createdAt" DESC LIMIT 1; the daily create cap count(*) … AND "createdAt" > now() - interval '1 day'; the A1/A2 probe's share LATERAL
indexes.explain: Index Scan using shares_owner_idx, no Sort

indexes.name: shares_expires_idx
indexes.query: HOUSEKEEPING prune-shares: DELETE FROM shares WHERE kind='REVIEW' AND "expiresAt" < now() - interval '7 days'

indexes.name: shares_game_idx
indexes.query: ON DELETE CASCADE from games (FK index)

indexes.name: linked_accounts_userId_provider_key
indexes.query: GET /api/me (viewer LATERAL over the member's ≤ 2 links); ACC-1/ACC-3/ACC-6; the link transaction's FOR UPDATE

indexes.name: import_runs_userId_createdAt_idx
indexes.query: GET /api/me (newest active-or-recent run), ACC-7 GET /api/import/status (≤ 5 runs)

indexes.name: import_runs_one_active
indexes.query: one active run per account (23505 → 409 sync_running); the worker's context LATERAL

indexes.name: import_runs_waiting_idx
indexes.query: entitlement fan-out releaseWaitingImports (plan 8.5.4)

indexes.name: linked_accounts_verified_key
indexes.query: verifiedElsewhere (ACC-2/ACC-3 linked_elsewhere, the Lichess callback)

indexes.name: linked_accounts_autosync_idx
indexes.query: worker daily-sync backstop (D4-27)

indexes.name: game_players_linked_account_idx
indexes.query: ON DELETE SET NULL from linked_accounts (unlink)

indexes.name: import_cursors_pkey
indexes.query: the worker's import context and finish

indexes.name: mistakes_referenceId_key
indexes.query: report target check (W7), bank detail links, P7 coach subject: WHERE "referenceId" = $1 AND "userId" = $u

indexes.name: mistakes_userId_epdHash_key
indexes.query: J1 mistakes upsert ON CONFLICT ("userId","epdHash"); every later J1 statement joins back on this natural key
indexes.explain: unique arbiter index; Index Scan using mistakes_userId_epdHash_key

indexes.name: mistakes_userId_createdAt_idx
indexes.query: NEW-card intake order fallback (W2), user-delete cascade, P6 scope scans

indexes.name: mistake_occurrences_pkey
indexes.query: J1 idempotent insert; the moment ↔ mistake link WHERE "gameId" = $g AND ply = ANY($momentPlies) (A1/A2 bank fields, A6, the game-over count)

indexes.name: mistake_occurrences_mistakeId_idx
indexes.query: J1 occurrence recount; "seen in 3 games"; cascade from mistakes

indexes.name: training_cards_userId_itemKey_key
indexes.query: W1/W5/W6/R3 card lookup by API ref (FOR UPDATE); J1 card insert ON CONFLICT ("userId","itemKey") DO NOTHING

indexes.name: training_cards_mistakeId_key
indexes.query: A6 toggle; review bank fields LEFT JOIN training_cards c ON c."mistakeId" = m.id; cascade

indexes.name: training_cards_userId_deck_due_idx
indexes.query: R1/R2/R8/W2/HOME-1/getMe(): due counts, due preview ORDER BY due LIMIT 4, session build due <= $now ORDER BY due, id, bank keyset (due, id), upcoming histogram
indexes.explain: Index Scan using training_cards_userId_deck_due_idx; never a Seq Scan on training_cards

indexes.name: training_attempts_clientAttemptId_key
indexes.query: W1 duplicate pre-check WHERE "clientAttemptId" = ANY($ids) and the INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING race guard

indexes.name: training_attempts_userId_reviewedAt_idx
indexes.query: today's attempts (plan-step completion), session summary, week puzzles count (HOME-1), streak audits

indexes.name: training_attempts_puzzle_idx
indexes.query: W2/W3: exclude puzzles seen in the last 90 days (≤ 500 ids)
indexes.explain: Index Scan (or Bitmap Index Scan) using training_attempts_puzzle_idx

indexes.name: training_sessions_referenceId_key
indexes.query: runner ?s= resume, summary page, R3/W3/W4

indexes.name: training_sessions_userId_startedAt_idx
indexes.query: W2 ACTIVE reuse and the durable train-session count in one statement (startedAt > $now - 2 h)

indexes.name: training_days_pkey
indexes.query: R1/W1/HOME-1: week strip day >= $monday, today's caps upsert, frozen plan

indexes.name: theme_mastery_pkey
indexes.query: R1 mastery bars, R4 picker, W1 attempt upsert, J1 bankCount increments

indexes.name: training_profiles_pkey
indexes.query: rating, streaks, prefs (one PK read in R1/W1/W2; the J1 job-load LEFT JOIN)

indexes.name: reports_status_createdAt_idx
indexes.query: P12 admin queue

indexes.name: reports_targetType_targetRef_idx
indexes.query: W7 "already reported in the last 24 h" check

indexes.name: reports_reporterId_createdAt_idx
indexes.query: W7 durable limit: count(*) WHERE "reporterId" = $u AND "createdAt" > $now - 1 day (≤ 20 rows; P10's player reports too)
